reports.title: Loar Holdings Inc. Reports Q3 2026 Record Results and Upward Revision to 2026 Outlook and Full Year 2027 Outlook

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Outlook – Revised
section: “We’re raising our full year 2026 outlook for the third time this year,” said Glenn D’Alessandro, Loar Holdings Treasurer and Chief Financial Officer. “The increase reflects our confidence in being able to convert our record orders and current backlog into increased sales, profits and cash flow through the balance of 2026.” Our outlook for the full year 2026 includes:
